method: Reviewed the complete lesson and metadata checkpoint against the preserved synthetic fixture and current Python AST, Tree-sitter, and Aider repo-map primary documentation. Ran the issue-specific 16-check audit and the 29-check W6 verifier; all three Python fences compiled and ranking/partial-index fixtures ran. Rebuilt static output and inspected the production lesson in light and dark themes. No provider calls were made.
limitations: The four-question provider run, its full responses, and the aggregate substring scorer were not recovered; its historical scores do not establish accuracy or causal search benefit.
The repository-scale scan summaries lack preserved selected-file listings and original scan traces; they do not establish relevance or savings for a target task.
The lexical index fixture is synthetic and does not evaluate real-repository retrieval quality or complete semantic references.
No provider, real repository benchmark, or production indexing service was exercised.
